method: Read-only inspection of supplied official headers, Ubuntu .deb packages, and x86_64 ELF files; official files were not edited.

execution_limits.reason: The official runtime and CPython 3.10 extension are Linux x86_64 ELF files. This host has no usable Ubuntu/WSL/container runtime or installed official eCAL/protobuf development headers and libraries.
execution_limits.required_next_validation: Compile and execute on Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 with official eCAL 5.13.3, official robot SDK/common .deb, protobuf, ROS Humble, and bundled original executables. Static inspection does not establish dynamic mission acceptance.

binding_evidence.scope: The exact supplied x86_64 CPython 3.10 extension, not hypothetical alternate SDK versions.

standUp.conversion: Member function result EAX is zero-extended through mov edi,eax, then passed to PyLong_FromSize_t at PLT address 0x16b10.

move.conversion: Member function result is converted by mov edi,eax and PyLong_FromSize_t.

attitudeControl.conversion: Member function result is converted by mov edi,eax and PyLong_FromSize_t.

binding_evidence.conclusion: These three supplied Python bindings return an unsigned integer status, not None. Keep allow_void_status disabled for this bundle.

contract: Use actual methods checkConnect and standUp; documentation variants checkConnection/standUP are not the supplied header names.
Nonzero move speeds: abs(vx)>=0.05 m/s, abs(vy)>=0.1 m/s, abs(yaw)>=0.02 rad/s; documented maxima 3, 1, 3 respectively. Zero is permitted.
attitudeControl roll/pitch/yaw/height rates are within +/-0.5; zero is permitted.
Before changing move/attitude command family, send matching-family zero, observe stationary feedback, call standUp, wait at least 4 seconds, then require fresh feedback and a new image.
passive is not a normal stop; no public shooting function exists in the official SDK.

native_simulator.config_path: ../config.yaml relative to simulator working directory, parsed before model selection
native_simulator.model_override: argv[1] supplies scene path; there is no native --headless flag.
native_simulator.glfw: Native executable constructs GLFW before loading scene. A machine without a display requires Xvfb for this process; Python EGL does not remove that requirement.
native_simulator.physics: Original executable performs mj_step. Python task3 backend only replays original RobotState through mj_forward for RGB rendering and the virtual ray referee.
native_simulator.startup: mj_makeData + mj_forward, no mj_resetDataKeyframe call. Preserve official base qpos0 height 0.65 m and zero initial hinge qpos; original home keyframe is not automatically loaded.
native_simulator.sensors: Preserve official 52-value sensor order: 12 joint position, 12 joint velocity, 12 actuator force, quaternion4, gyro3, accelerometer3, position3, velocity3.
native_simulator.imu: Original site imu is identity at base origin, allowing actual RobotState.position to map directly to the render mirror freejoint translation.
native_simulator.joint_order: FR, FL, RR, RL (FAR,FBL,RAR,RBL), each ABAD,HIP,KNEE. Protobuf arrays are grouped by joint family.
native_simulator.rendering: No native RGB sensor_msgs/Image publisher found. Native camera name is this_camera; task3_camera is the added read-only render camera.
native_simulator.controller_configuration: Official run_sim.sh switches motor_platform_type to 5 for MuJoCo; 8 is UE. Patch only the staged copied configuration, never the official source tree.

state_field_binary_evidence.method: Static x86_64 ELF disassembly and supplied robot_sdk.pb.h repeated-field layout; addresses are ELF virtual addresses.
state_field_binary_evidence.state_object: JszrSdkBridge embeds RobotState at this+0xb8; repeated fields retain their actual protobuf lengths.
state_field_binary_evidence.joint_array_lengths: Loop 0x199e3..0x19b2d runs four times and Add(0) initializes every q/qd/tau joint-family repeated field. The nine bridge-consumed arrays each have length four.
state_field_binary_evidence.quat_length: 0x19b85..0x19bf3 adds four entries to quat at this+0x1e8.
state_field_binary_evidence.gyro_length: 0x19bf8..0x19c4b adds three entries to gyro at this+0x200.
state_field_binary_evidence.acc_length: 0x19c50..0x19ca3 adds three entries to acc at this+0x218.
state_field_binary_evidence.position_length: 0x19ca8..0x19cfb adds three entries to position at this+0x260.
state_field_binary_evidence.v_world_length: 0x19d00..0x19d53 adds three entries to v_world at this+0x278.
state_field_binary_evidence.sensor_check: CheckSensor at 0x18110 enables IMU and position copy blocks after finding original imu_quat and frame_pos sensor names. The task3 derived scene preserves those names and the original exact sensor layout.
state_field_binary_evidence.joint_state_copy: Run at 0x19f60, block 0x1a7fc..0x1aa74 copies interleaved official joint position/velocity/actuator-force sensor values to the per-family arrays.
state_field_binary_evidence.imu_copy: Run block 0x1aa80..0x1aaf3 copies sensordata[36:46] to quat4, gyro3, acc3 in original MuJoCo wxyz order.
state_field_binary_evidence.position_velocity_copy: Run block 0x1aaf8..0x1ab50 copies sensordata[46:52] to position3 and v_world3 each publication. These are actual supplied native fields, not synthesized fallback values.

ecal.callback_signature: void(const char*, const RobotState&, long long time_us, long long clock, long long id)
ecal.id: ecal_callback.h initializes id=0. ecal_publisher.h SetID(long long) documents a signed application-controlled subscriber topic filter ID, with 0 meaning no ID. It is not a unique publisher identity, need not be positive, and is forwarded as diagnostic metadata without continuity assertions.
ecal.source_clock: Separate per-publication writer clock, not the SetID value.
ecal.send_time: Publisher send timestamp in microseconds; its epoch follows the loaded eCAL time plugin and must not be assumed to be Unix epoch.
ecal.freshness_mapping: publication_monotonic = bridge_receive_monotonic - (bridge_receive_ecal_us - source_send_ecal_us)/1e6. Check transit and host queue age; retain raw RobotState.time_stamp without assigning an undocumented unit.
ecal.source_isolation: Read-only state and command subscribers reject publisher count greater than one on either fixed official topic; command observer has no callback and never sends/forwards controls.
ecal.api_verification: eCAL::core CMake imported target, protobuf subscriber callback, GetPublisherCount, Destroy, RemReceiveCallback, eCAL::Time::GetMicroSeconds, and IsSynchronized verified against supplied 5.13.3 headers/CMake metadata.

send_time_binary_evidence.call_site: 0x1cbbc sets RCX=-1, 0x1cbc3 sets RDX=-1, 0x1cbd6 calls eCAL::CPublisher::Send(CPayloadWriter&,long long,long long). The thunk likewise sets both arguments to -1 before 0x1cc46.
send_time_binary_evidence.meaning: The original simulator passes the default time sentinel -1 and default acknowledge timeout -1. It does not pass mjData.time, milliseconds, or a custom timestamp to the eCAL Send timestamp parameter.
send_time_binary_evidence.default_branch: In supplied eCAL::CPublisher::Send at 0xf5d50, default time branch 0xf5e40 calls eCAL::Time::GetMicroSeconds via PLT 0x6fdc0, then passes that result as Write timestamp.
send_time_binary_evidence.rmw_header_distinction: Run also calls std::chrono::system_clock::now for its RMW Header. ECALPublisher sends the payload with default eCAL time, independently of that Header.
send_time_binary_evidence.mapping_conclusion: Mapping callback source_ecal_time_us through bridge receive eCAL time and monotonic time is consistent with this exact supplied native publication path.

first_source_clock_binary_evidence.conclusion: The supplied eCAL writer starts its first publication clock at 1; min=1 agrees with the inspected bundle. No native/Python contract change was made.
first_source_clock_binary_evidence.constructor: CDataWriter constructor at 0x110680 clears xmm1 at 0x1106ea, then writes its zero vector to this+0x2a8 (topic filter id) and this+0x2b0 (writer clock) at 0x110966.
first_source_clock_binary_evidence.increment_before_use: PrepareWrite at 0x10cce0 calls RefreshSendCounter at 0x10cd14. RefreshSendCounter at 0x10c310 increments this+0x2b0 at 0x10c322; PrepareWrite reads it at 0x10cd2c for the outgoing sample.
first_source_clock_binary_evidence.limits: Static evidence applies to the bundled eCAL 5.13.3 library. Actual Ubuntu packets and runtime behavior remain to be validated.

ubuntu_acceptance_still_required: Build the native bridge against original supplied packages.
Launch exactly one unchanged robot_mujoco and one unchanged mc_ctrl; confirm original file hashes remain unchanged.
Confirm standing contact dynamics and 12 actual joint trajectories; turn left and right through 90 degrees via official SDK.
Verify matching-family zero and standUp mode transitions produce fresh stationary state before attitude aiming.
Execute full three-target RGB/AprilTag mission and inspect per-shot target identity, score, timestamps, and no synthetic motion fallback.
Verify bridge/runtime stop on a second state or command publisher and stale physics feedback.
